{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue dtype and first few values
print("Revenue dtype:", sales['revenue'].dtype)
print("First 5 revenue values:", sales['revenue'].head(5).tolist())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Number of refunded orders:", (sales['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check for QA orders
qa_mask = (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99')
print("Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", qa_mask.sum())

# Check if 'LOYAL' is in customer_segment
print("Unique customer_segment values:", sales['customer_segment'].unique())"}
